body: A US F-35B stealth fighter based at Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni made a precautionary landing at Kochi Airport on the morning of November 20 after the aircraft showed an abnormal indication, and departed the airport at about 11:45 a.m. on November 22 once maintenance was complete, Kochi Prefecture said. The fighter had remained parked at the airport after the landing.

The Kochi Airport office of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism said the fighter's arrival and departure had no effect on civilian flight operations. The Defense Ministry's Chugoku-Shikoku Defense Bureau said the safe operation of US military aircraft is a top priority and that it will continue to ask the US military to ensure thorough safety management. Another US military aircraft made a precautionary landing at Kochi Airport in March 2025 and remained parked there for 42 days.
en.summary: A US F-35B stealth fighter based at Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni made a precautionary landing at Kochi Airport on November 20 after an abnormal indication, and departed on November 22 after maintenance. Civilian flights were not affected.
en.title: US F-35B fighter departs Kochi Airport after precautionary landing

body: 駐山口縣岩國基地的美軍F-35B匿蹤戰機11月20日上午在高知機場預防著陸。據高知縣表示，該機當天上午飛行時機體出現與平常不同的徵兆，為避免危險而預防著陸，隨後駐機接受整備。11月22日上午11時45分左右，整備完成後該機自高知機場離場。
國土交通省高知機場事務所表示，戰機的起降未對民航機運作造成影響。防衛省中國四國防衛局表示，美軍機運用以確保安全為大前提，將繼續要求美軍在安全管理上做到萬全。高知機場2025年3月也曾有美軍機預防著陸，當時駐機42天。
zh.summary: 駐岩國基地的美軍F-35B戰機11月20日上午因機體異常在高知機場預防著陸，整備完成後11月22日上午離場；民航運作未受影響。
zh.title: 美軍F-35B戰機高知機場預防著陸、整備後離場
